experimental_design.evidence: inferred: We compared the global proteome and phosphoproteome between control and TP53RK-deficient HT29 cells using tandem mass tag (TMT) labeling for quantitative analysis.

factor_value.evidence: inferred: Tryptic peptides (400 μg) from each sample (triplicates of TP53RK knockout (KO) and GFP KO) were labeled with 2.4 mg of each TMT tag.

number_of_biological_replicates.evidence: Control and TP53RK-deficient HT29 cells (three replicates each) were lysed and digested with trypsin using S-Trap according to the manufacturer's protocol.

number_of_fractions.evidence: The labeled peptides were pooled and fractionated by basic reverse-phase liquid chromatography (bRPLC) into 25 fractions, 5% of which were analyzed for global proteomics.
